datasets.name: ds_categorical_usage
datasets.query: SELECT trip_year_month, rider_type, rideable_type_clean, time_of_day_bucket, is_weekend, total_trips, avg_duration_minutes, avg_distance_km FROM citi_bike_catalog.gold.mart_categorical_usage

datasets.name: ds_temporal_mobility
datasets.query: SELECT started_date, trip_year_month, start_hour, day_of_week_name, is_weekend, rider_type, rideable_type_clean, total_trips, avg_duration_minutes FROM citi_bike_catalog.gold.mart_temporal_mobility

datasets.name: ds_dim_stations
datasets.query: SELECT station_id, station_name, station_lat, station_lng, total_departures, avg_duration_minutes, member_share_pct, ebike_share_pct FROM citi_bike_catalog.gold.dim_stations ORDER BY total_departures DESC LIMIT 25
